purpose: Learn repeatable creator success mechanisms without copying creator wording or forcing one template onto every asset.

reward_regimes.notes: Leaderboard rewards for this period followed the previous rules; do not retroactively evaluate them using the engagement-bonus regime.
Eligible text content may receive an engagement bonus based on genuine engagement; qualifying reader trades can also generate commissions. Treat these as distinct outcome channels.

learn_these_success_mechanisms.question: What timely question, uncertainty, or decision does this post resolve for a crypto trader?
Does each major claim have a current, checkable reason?
Does the post explain what would weaken or invalidate the thesis?
Which presentation best serves this idea?
signals: short observation when one insight is enough
deep dive when evidence needs context
chart annotation when visual evidence matters
question when a genuine discussion is useful
avoid: same opening, length, section order, and CTA on every post

learn_these_success_mechanisms.question: Is there a real point readers can discuss or challenge?
Does the content meet current program rules and contain a relevant coin cashtag or trading widget where required?

generation_policy.principle: Reuse validated mechanisms, not sentences or rigid templates.
require_per_post: new thesis or a clearly new angle
format selected for the idea rather than by fixed rotation
do_not_reuse_as_fixed_template: identical target/entry/stop layout for every asset
same narrative angle across consecutive posts

rules: Do not claim causation from a single post or creator-level leaderboard total.
Keep creator-period reward evidence separate from individual-post performance.
Compare engagement-bonus-era posts only with appropriate reward-regime context.
Promote a strategy only after repeated evidence across multiple posts and record confidence and sample size.
Use the user's own reward updates as feedback, explicitly marked owner-reported until independently verified.

current_status.reason: NIC joins first-party creator-period leaderboard rewards to dated public posts in the matching 7-day reward period and the preceding 7-day lookback. It must collect and verify complete 7-day and 14-day windows for every creator in the observed leaderboard before declaring cohort learning ready. Only then may it compare higher-reward and lower-reward creator cohorts, with at least two creators and five posts per tier. The writer applies an evidence-led layout hypothesis only when numeric-evidence and source-link rates are both at least 20 percentage points higher in the higher-reward cohort. Weekly reward totals are never assigned to individual posts. Endpoint blocks, unresolved identity, missing dates, or pagination limits remain visible blockers.

source_notes.supports: Write-to-Earn upgrade effective 2026-10-19 and genuine engagement bonus mechanics.
